sourceClaims.claim: Simple, Customize and Basic are three distinct source compositions with source-specific typography and geometry
optional regions generalize the source compositions without owning application empty-data state
secondary titles and descriptions reuse the accessible supporting-text role; primary titles, illustrations and source values remain unchanged
Empty State action widths are source minima and localized labels remain inside growing shells.

evidence.source-integrity: pass: three source variants and their distinct typography/geometry are checked against extracted source references
evidence.structural-contract: pass: all five roots are classified and optional visual/title/description/action regions remain composable
evidence.runtime-browser: not-applicable: Empty State owns no loading, retry, announcement or visibility controller
evidence.accessibility: pass: titles and descriptions exceed 4.5:1 in all four compositions on four light surfaces, no live role is added and actions stay native
evidence.focused-visual: pass: component snapshots preserve the three source geometries, primary titles and illustration paint with documented supporting-text correction Rounded-control regressions additionally verify A5 at the rendered HTML/paint boundary.
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: readable Data Workspace empty results recover all rows through the native reset button activated with Enter
evidence.responsive-content-stress: pass: long title and description remain contained at 200 percent text size in a 280px fluid composition at a 360px viewport; existing native-action stress also remains covered Scoped rounded-control checks retain active typography and content containment; exact cases and observed counts are recorded in rounded-control-alignment.md.

staticVisual: pass: Simple, Customize and Basic source matrices are static composition evidence
pass: focused rounded-control regressions cover A5 with separate line, shell, and paint assertions as applicable
realInteractionVisual: not-applicable: Empty State has no root hover, focus, active or disabled interaction contract
runtimeBehavior: not-applicable: empty-data lifecycle and nested Button/Link behavior are consumer or nested-family owned

interactionEvidence.manualStateWalk: pass: all source variants, long title/description, narrow container and nested action focus integration inspected

findings.description: Simple title and Basic description no longer use the low-contrast source Gray 200 in production. The existing accessible supporting role yields at least 4.575:1 across supported surfaces; original SVGs remain unchanged.
Empty State action widths are source minima and localized labels remain inside growing shells.

knownLimitations: dynamic announcements are consumer-owned and are not implied by ordinary empty presentation
custom foreground/background combinations require consumer contrast validation; this episode certifies Chromium only
